title: PMV experiment run spec, version 1
description: runs/<run_id>/run_spec.json, written once before run_started. spec_sha256 is the SHA-256 of these exact bytes, at most 1 MiB. Documentation only: the authoritative validator is pmv.experiment_spec.parse_run_spec, which also requires the bytes to equal the canonical re-encoding. Canonical bytes: sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII, no floats, one trailing newline. JSON booleans are never integers.

split.description: protected_holdout is refused in Step 6 and never appears

calibration.description: A safe value object, or null. Safe values (pmv.experiment_spec.validate_safe_value): null, booleans, integers, strings that are identifiers, exact decimal text, canonical UTC timestamps, or SHA-256 digests and do not look like secret material, lists of safe values, and objects with identifier keys; nesting depth at most 8. No floats, free text, or paths.
